title: Moment 1: Day one, Setup rating
intro: A short made-up storyboard from endgame.life. Maya opens her new dashboard for the first time. Nothing here is real and nothing is sent.

steps.say: Made-up example, nothing is sent. Maya opens her new dashboard, and it checks what it can read.
Her setup rating is 35 of 100, based on what her assistant can actually read.
Email, calendar, and tasks are connected.
Money is missing. A read-only view would unlock spending and subscriptions.
The next step is one connector, about two minutes, and her rating goes to 45.
